pr.title: Sindri engine P4: the interpreter, the worker, desk Steps and the bridge

scope: P4-only diff vs the union of origin/main 3e3fde3b, P2 187206bc and API P2 95d1e33d
publish_note: PR comments blocked by hooks this week; resolutions recorded here and in evidence.md

issues.summary: Desk timeout 'always parks whatever then: says' is tested only for then: retry
issues.resolution: fixed: desk-timeout theory over every then: (red fef98236 cherry-picked; fix 505e52a7)

issues.summary: No journey evidence for answer, command, cancel, protected-answer challenge, events --follow, desk-timeout park, causation routing
issues.resolution: pending: journeys for answer, command, cancel, the challenge, --follow, desk-timeout park and causation re-run through sindri-prove.sh after the interpreter fixes

issues.summary: Journey 8's +4 rows aren't explained by two refusals
issues.resolution: answered: the other two rows are the IssueNonce audit rows each CLI call writes first; the re-run prints the new rows by type

issues.summary: Journey 5 shows only --json alreadyApplied; journey 10 injects events with sqlite3
issues.resolution: answered: journey 5 re-run captures the human 'already applied' line; journey 10 is labelled a bridge-in-isolation check until API P3 gives a real item.routed producer

issues.summary: Held-event tests mix the wall clock and the time-skipped clock
issues.resolution: answered: the held-event tests measure from OccurredAt against the time-skipped clock, which only moves forward per fixture; deriving both from env time is a follow-up if the fixture is ever shared

reviewers.focus: event bridge, held window, ledger, home stand-ins

issues.summary: Held window (24 h eventHold) re-sends an item event to instances started after it (a later attempt included)
issues.resolution: fixed 93eda8ce (red), e78797d3: redelivery only to instances started at or before the event, within a 1-minute visibility-lag window

issues.summary: Redeliver runs one visibility List per held event every 5 s and opens a new Temporal client per call
issues.resolution: fixed e78797d3: one visibility query per item per run; TemporalFrontend caches one client per target and namespace

issues.summary: An unparseable ledger item stalls the bridge cursor for good
issues.resolution: fixed e78797d3: items that aren't ItemKeys are logged and skipped; non-transient delivery errors are logged and passed

issues.summary: Claim treats a pending claim as fresh; a retried protected answer is refused and its claim released though it applied
issues.resolution: fixed d4689968 (red, bounded), 0f004f3c: NonceClaim is Fresh/Pending/Applied; Pending resends the same Update id; only a fresh claim is given back; Applied recreates a gone claim

issues.summary: Cursor and fact files renamed into place without fsync
issues.resolution: fixed e78797d3: flush to disk before the rename; HomeFactStore rewrites a file whose length differs

issues.summary: Cursor rewritten once per ledger row
issues.resolution: fixed e78797d3: the cursor advances once per batch

issues.summary: EventAsync doc says eventHold expiry is open; Hold.cs implements it
issues.resolution: fixed 505e52a7: EventAsync doc comment

issues.summary: Release can delete a claim whose Update may have applied
issues.resolution: fixed with data-integrity-guardian-3 (0f004f3c)

issues.summary: Challenge's version binding is checked in the handler, not in the Update validator
issues.resolution: answered: the window is milliseconds and the validator's park-reason fit refuses most moves; carrying the redeemed version on AnswerGiven is a P5 hardening item

issues.summary: Stand-in nonce isn't bound to instance/version; spec SND-WF-009 text differs
issues.resolution: answered: the stand-in is a listed known gap; nonces move to API P1's table with issue time and instance binding

issues.summary: IssueChallenge row CLI names recipe approve for instance challenges
issues.resolution: declined: CliForm admits one command by design (UI E-16); the refusal text is built in Core Authorization; only a direct API caller sees it

issues.summary: A report racing the desk deadline is answered 'parked: timeout' but left in _report
issues.resolution: fixed 1c9ad45c (red), 505e52a7: a report at the deadline wins; _report cleared when taken

issues.summary: Updates accepted with an ending trigger are never settled; the workflow never completes
issues.resolution: fixed 1c9ad45c (red), 505e52a7: Close() settles queued Updates and a pending report before AllHandlersFinished

issues.summary: An event that fits the current wait is expired instead of consumed when older than eventHold
issues.resolution: fixed 466bfede (red), 505e52a7: ExpireHeld skips an event that fits the current wait

issues.summary: StartOf mints instance.Id with a different formula than WorkflowInstanceId.Of
issues.resolution: fixed 702f2700 (red), 505e52a7: StartOf uses WorkflowInstanceId.Of

issues.summary: Mirrored ledger rows drop the trigger's actor (spec §5.6)
issues.resolution: fixed 702f2700 (red), 505e52a7: rows carry the trigger actor and the instance tenant and ring

issues.summary: A LoadRecipe failure leaves a permanently 'starting' instance
issues.resolution: fixed 505e52a7: only SND-RECIPE-002/-003 are non-retryable in LoadRecipe

issues.summary: Held events aren't expired during an active desk Step
issues.resolution: fixed 505e52a7: held events expire during a desk wait

issues.summary: No checked-in recorded-history replay fixtures
issues.resolution: answered: checked-in recorded histories and Workflow.Patched are P5's entry criterion (first phase that changes the interpreter after P4 instances exist)

issues.summary: §3.4 and §3.8 don't reflect rev 8.2's desk-timeout park
issues.resolution: handed to owner: §3.4/§3.8 rev 8.2 wording is a spec edit

issues.summary: AGENTS.md, sindri help and two docstrings say invalid input exits 1; it exits 2
issues.resolution: fixed 03a5f7f1 (AGENTS.md), 1fad519b (red), 96d4c95b (help, docstrings)

issues.summary: 'The interpreter's interface' describes contract-time stubs that no longer exist
issues.resolution: fixed 03a5f7f1: the section describes head

issues.summary: Doc says --needs-me lists takeovers; NeedsYou is false while taken over
issues.resolution: fixed 03a5f7f1: --needs-me doesn't list takeovers until P5's idle takeover sets NeedsYou

issues.summary: status, events and complete refuse a bare item the write verbs accept
issues.resolution: fixed ee36c01c: status, events and complete resolve a bare item or id

issues.summary: --follow never observes an interrupt and polls forever after its pipe closes
issues.resolution: fixed ee36c01c: Interrupt (Ctrl-C, SIGTERM) for --follow; a closed stdout ends follow with 0

issues.summary: events on an unknown address prints 'no events', exit 0
issues.resolution: fixed ee36c01c: events of an unknown instance is SND-WF-001

issues.summary: §6.3 GET instance and instance-events routes aren't mapped or listed as a gap
issues.resolution: fixed ee36c01c: GET /sindri/workflow/instances/{id} and /{id}/events?after=

issues.summary: Route table lacks P4's five routes; IssueChallenge row lacks the instance actions
issues.resolution: fixed bb3b171b: seven routes and the instance challenge actions in sindri.md

issues.summary: PR body's head, merge SHAs and gate evidence predate the current head
issues.resolution: pending: PR body refresh at the final head

issues.summary: list opens one connection and runs one Query per row; query failures drop rows silently
issues.resolution: partly fixed e78797d3 (cached client); per-row Query parallelism and surfacing query failures are a follow-up

issues.summary: Tokens(1_500_000) prints 1500k
issues.resolution: fixed 96d4c95b: 1.5M

issues.summary: Unknown-verb usage misses --nonce/--json
issues.resolution: fixed 96d4c95b: usage names --nonce/--json
